Our Story

A family lunch counter with Saigon roots

Saigon Subs and Rolls is a family-owned lunch spot in the heart of downtown Cincinnati. Since 2016, we have been serving traditional Vietnamese meals — the banh mi, pho, and spring rolls we grew up with — to the downtown lunch crowd.

Everything starts with fresh ingredients, prepared each day in a relaxed little counter where the line moves fast and everybody gets a friendly hello.

  • Fresh ingredientsPrepared daily for every sandwich, soup, and roll.
  • Quick serviceBuilt for the lunch hour — in, out, and back to work happy.
  • Family-owned & friendlyA relaxed setting and a warm welcome, every weekday.
